visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: A Shallow Copy Shares the Address
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Changing the city in the copy should leave the original in Pune, but the original city changes too.

solution.explanation: Object.assign copies only the top level: copy.address is the same object as original.address. A change inside it shows up in both. The JSON round trip builds new nested objects as well.
